title: ACTIONS SPEAK LOUDER THAN WORDS: AGENT DECISIONS REVEAL IMPLICIT BIASES IN LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating decision-making disparities (Demographic Parity Difference) among language agents endowed with varying gender personas (male, female, non-binary) in simulated scenarios, and measuring explicit bias via direct question-answering prompts.

Evaluating decision-making disparities (Demographic Parity Difference) among language agents endowed with varying racial and ethnic personas (e.g., White, Black, Asian, Native American) in simulated scenarios, and measuring explicit bias via direct question-answering prompts.

Evaluating decision-making disparities (Demographic Parity Difference) among language agents endowed with varying political ideology personas (e.g., liberal, conservative) in simulated scenarios, and measuring explicit bias via direct question-answering prompts.
